evaluator.policy: Pinned protocol model, matching the StageBench reference. Record actual resolved model; do not silently substitute. Human evaluation is a separately labeled track.

scale.4: Consistently excellent, supported by concrete evidence

axes.criterion: Readable anticipation, contact, reaction, and handoff; carrier, ball and fire timing agree.
Legible silhouettes, intentional proportions, coherent palette and materials; motion looks armed, active and settled.
Every world brief and mechanism constraint met; honest evidence; appropriate footprints, clocks and visible paint/flight causes.
Ten meaningfully different mechanisms per world, interpreted specifically for the theme rather than superficial reskins.

aggregation: Each world: sum(weight * rating / 4). Suite: equal mean of three worlds. Any failed computed gate makes the suite ineligible (score null). Unobserved visual axes remain null; never turn unrated into zero or infer success from compilation.
